name: Black Bridge
body:
School illusion (shadow); Level bard 2, cleric/oracle 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Effect a bridge of semi real force up to 10 feet wide, 1 inch thick and up to 30 ft../level long
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell draws from the plane of shadow to create a bridge of solid darkness. It can support 200 pounds per caster level. If the weight limit of the bridge is exceeded, the most recent creature or object to enter the area of effect falls through the bridge as though it weren’t there, this process continues until the weight limit is no longer exceeded.
